normative_extracts.quote: Signals model a reactive dependency graph with glitch-free push-pull propagation.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Glitch-free push-pull propagation over an acyclic observer graph.

production_failures.symptom: Infinite effect loop saturating the main thread
production_failures.root_cause: An effect reads and writes the same signal without a guard.
production_failures.mitigation: Derive values via pure Computed signals instead of mutating inside an Effect.

production_failures.symptom: UI fails to update after state change
production_failures.root_cause: Signal read performed outside the synchronous scope of computed/effect (after await).
production_failures.mitigation: Capture all signal reads before any asynchronous operation.
